name: English Boost: Grammar & Vocabulary
description: For learners and teachers: everyday grammar, sentence building, and useful vocabulary for school and work communication.

options: She go to school every day.
She goes to school every day.
She going to school every day.
She gone to school every day.
questions.explanation: With she/he/it, add -s to the verb in the present simple: she goes.

questions.prompt: What is the past tense of "teach"?
questions.explanation: Teach is irregular: teach - taught - taught.

questions.prompt: Which word is a synonym of "happy"?
Choose the correct article: "She is ___ honest person."
questions.explanation: Honest starts with a vowel sound, so we use an.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is in the future tense?
questions.explanation: Will + verb shows a future action.

questions.prompt: What does the idiom "break the ice" mean?
questions.explanation: To break the ice means to ease the first awkward moments of conversation.
Child has the irregular plural children.

questions.prompt: Which word best completes: "The exam was ___ than I expected."
questions.explanation: Than signals a comparison, so use the comparative harder.
Modern is the opposite of ancient.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct preposition: "He arrived ___ Monday morning."
questions.explanation: Use on with days of the week.
Manila names a specific place, so it is a proper noun and capitalized.

options: A place where books are kept and borrowed
questions.explanation: A library is where people read and borrow books.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: "They ___ playing outside now."
questions.explanation: They pairs with are in the present continuous.
Questions end with a question mark (?).

questions.prompt: What is the main verb in: "Maria quickly finished her homework."?
questions.explanation: Finished is the action word - the verb.
